scope: Preserve V8U, V8V and V8W, reuse the cached V8W diagonal impact cases, vary facade and projectile meshes independently around the 50 mm baseline, then repeat a non-eroding diagonal control and conditionally its cross-mesh decomposition if the 10 percent impulse gate still fails. V8X localizes numerical mesh sensitivity; it does not tune the gate and is not a JT9D, whole-aircraft or global WTC 1 impact model.
